text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day. After receiving an offer to 
appear on a TV show, I found myself on a 
deserted island alongside Sakura Bakushin 
O.

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
"The ‘Win Through Bonds★Survival Race’! 
And last but not least, introducing... 
Team Sakura Bakushin O!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Our goal is victory! To live up to the 
word 'Leader' emblazoned on this outfit!! 
I'll guide you with all my might, 
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right! Trainer, are you ready?! 
Bakushin Fireee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the survival race began. 
Determined not to hold her back, I pumped 
myself up and leapt past the starting 
line—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Right! No, wait, left! Right there! 
Now's your chance, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flap!)

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
Team Sakura Bakushin O! With magnificent 
coordination, we reeled in the Master of 
the River at blazing speed! "The Trial of 
the Unseen" is complete!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaaaaaaan! There's a sign here 
saying 'Do not cross this edge/bridge' 
thoughhhhh!
choice_data_list:
Then let's Bakushin right down the middle 
of the bridge!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! I don't really understand, but if 
Trainer says so, it must be fine! 
—BAKUSHIIIIIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Team Sakura Bakushin O has 
brilliantly cleared the "Trial of Wit"! 
They're pulling away in first place!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
However, the difficulty of the trial 
spikes in the second half! Will the bond 
between the two of you be enough to 
overcome it!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! I see the goal post over there! Just 
a little further, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Yeah! The last one is... the "Trial of 
Telepathy"?

Right! The last one is... the "Trial of 
Telepathy"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ho! It seems all we must do is match our 
answers to the questions! Simple enough! 
...Now then, hit me with your question!!!!

text_block_list.name: Show MC's Recorded Voice
text_block_list.text:
"Question! What comes to mind when you 
hear 'Sakura'? You have 10 seconds! Answer 
simultaneously!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! This is an easy one, Trainer! There's 
no way to get it wrong!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod firmly in response to Sakura 
Bakushin O's words. ...However, just 
knowing the answer isn't enough. I need to 
accurately anticipate how she will answer—

text_block_list.name: Show MC's Recorded Voice
text_block_list.text:
"'...5, 4, 3, 2, 1, time's up! Now, let's 
hear everyone's answers together— When you 
hear "Sakura", you think of...?!'"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Show MC's Recorded Voice
text_block_list.text:
"Buzz! Too bad! You failed the 'Trial of 
Hearts in Sync'! Time for a ride down the 
giant slide to the bottom of the cliff!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ka-clunk!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Chowaaaa--?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The world froze, and opening my eyes... I 
was stunned. Right in front of me was a 
sheer precipice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't have overthought it; I should 
have just answered honestly...
choice_data_list:
(Victory was right within reach, but like 
this—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whew, what a thrilling slide that was!! I 
have zero memory of actually sliding down 
it, though!!!! Wahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that is one magnificent cliff!! 
Could we call it a hill with a 20-meter 
elevation difference?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
An ordinary person would surely fall into 
despair! —However, remember, Trainer! 
Remember the words I proclaimed before the 
start!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Our goal is victory! To live up to the 
word 'Leader' emblazoned on this outfit!! 
I'll guide you with all my might, 
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!!! When I am wearing this outfit, I 
am no mere Class Representative!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—The "Leader" Class Representative!!!! The 
one who guides everyone toward hope and 
miracles!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time!! I shall guide you!! To 
the top of the cliff... and toward 
victory!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having said that, Sakura Bakushin O 
climbed onto a higher rock and—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come on!! Let's go, Trainer!! Take my hand 
and chant with me!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —Bakushiiiiin?!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
“—Though you narrowly missed first place, 
congratulations on winning the Best 
Partner Award! Tell us how you're feeling 
right now!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The Best Partner Award on a stage where 
bonds are truly tested!! We missed out on 
first place in the race, but this is a 
victory in its own right! Ahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
The scene at the bottom of the cliff was 
truly moving! What did you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
We were able to pull through thanks to 
you, Leader!
Our bond has grown even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Right? Exactly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However! You are also amazing for not 
giving up and taking my hand, Trainer! You 
get a gold star!!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
Look at them praising each other! As 
expected of the best partners! I'm really 
looking forward to seeing you shine in 
your races!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Turning a crisis into strength is 
what being a class rep is all about, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please look forward to seeing what our 
powered-up selves can do from here on 
out!!!!
